opportunities.title: APEX Awards

amount.raw: Applicants can apply for up to £200,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, holding a permanent or fixed-term position covering the duration of the award, based in a UK University or UK not-for-profit research organisation. Lead applicant may include up to two Co-applicants covering different Academy remits.
opportunities.summary: Cross-disciplinary, curiosity-driven research awards in partnership with the Royal Society, Royal Academy of Engineering and Leverhulme Trust, promoting collaboration across science, engineering, social sciences and humanities. Awards up to 24 months.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call, across all career stages. Previous successful recipients of this award are not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences, working in partnership with a GLAM organisation or performing arts organisation.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: The symposium covers travel, accommodation, and visa costs. Seed funding available for collaborations.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany, in the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Research collaboration symposium on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', bringing together early career researchers from the UK and Germany to encourage collaboration and networking.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: 80 per cent of salary costs, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC; three-year fellowship

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation. British citizens and EEA nationals eligible regardless of doctorate origin; any nationality with a UK doctorate eligible. Must have completed Viva Voce between 1 April 2024 and 1 April 2027.
opportunities.summary: Three-year fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers to pursue an independent research project towards completion of a significant piece of publishable research, funded by DSIT.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in the humanities and social sciences ordinarily resident in the UK, holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based HEI or IRO, intending to pursue original independent research.
opportunities.summary: Awards to promote acquisition and advancement of skills in areas such as quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities and languages, supporting innovative research methods through skills development, collaboration or dissemination.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: Up to £300,000 over 2 years (80% FEC; total project value at 100% FEC may not exceed £375,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute, of postdoctoral or above status, with Co-Applicants based overseas required.
opportunities.summary: International interdisciplinary research projects led by UK-based researchers in the humanities and social sciences, working with international partners, on the theme of Mobilities, ranging across SHAPE and STEM disciplines.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27

amount.raw: Up to £150,000 for 12 months (with Full Economic Costing at 80 per cent)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships providing opportunities for UK-based early- and mid-career researchers to develop skills, networks and careers in the creative, cultural, public, private and policy sectors, embedded in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: Funding of up to £4,000 (exceptional circumstances above £4,000 considered)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders on any scheme, or applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months who need support with submitting their application.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require, in addition to the amount already requested for research expenses, such as specific equipment, assistance for sensory impairment, caring costs, and support to make applications.
